{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or -0.50) and model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent history shows mean reversion toward lower prices after spikes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices when sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50 or 0.67) to capture momentum.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust current forecast upward by 2-5%.",
    "Cap forecast increases after sharp spikes (e.g., >70% from prior day) to prevent overshoot; use sentiment as trigger for moderation.",
    "When sentiment history shows rising positivity (e.g., 0.00 → 0.33 → 0.50), gradually increase forecast slope to reflect upward momentum.",
    "If model consistently underpredicts true outcomes in early days of a new sentiment trend, apply a 3-5% upward bias to compensate for lag."
  ]
}
